text: @local/dsh-outbound-proxy 是一个面向 DSH Host 的出站 HTTP(S) 代理插件，通过 Host 插件入口安装代理策略。它会优先采用行配置中的代理地址，其次读取启动环境变量，并在两者都未提供时使用本机 127.0.0.1:7890；也支持设置直连域名，保留回环地址直连。插件定位 Host 自带的代理模块并安装策略，卸载时释放策略。适合需要让 Harness 的出站网络请求经过本机 HTTP(S) 代理的场景。需要本机代理服务，不需要额外 API 密钥。

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy routes DSH Host outbound HTTP(S) requests through a local proxy. It installs a Host proxy policy using an explicit URL, then launch environment, then 127.0.0.1:7890. Direct-connect suffixes and loopback traffic can bypass it. A local proxy is required; no API key is needed.
让 DSH Host 的出站网页请求经由本机 HTTP 代理。
代理端口变了，想让插件自动跟随启动环境里的设置。
Route my Harness HTTP requests through the proxy running on this machine.
@local/dsh-outbound-proxy 的功能「出站请求代理」：插件激活时为 DSH Host 安装 HTTP(S) 代理策略。代理地址依次来自行配置、启动环境变量或本机默认地址，并可配置不经代理的域名；插件卸载时释放策略。
@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · dsh-outbound-proxy：让 DeepSeek Harness 的出站 HTTP(S) 请求走本机 HTTP 代理（Clash / mihomo 等）。端口跟随启动环境，插件行可单独覆盖。

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Dax233/dsh-outbound-proxy
```

也可在 DSH 插件页添加该 GitHub 地址，安装后重启 DSH Desktop。

配置见 `INSTALL.md` 与 `env/proxy.env` 示例；默认代理 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`。

---

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · @local/dsh-outbound-proxy：Host plugin for DeepSeek Harness that installs an outbound HTTP proxy policy in
the running Host process.

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Why：The Harness resolves its proxy policy once from the launch environment. A
desktop launch without `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` leaves every Node-side
request (`web_fetch`, HTTP MCP transports, account calls) connecting directly.
On a machine whose DNS answers come from a Clash-style fake-IP pool
(`198.18.0.0/15`), `web_fetch` refuses the request before it is sent:

```
URL hostname "www.google.com" resolves to a non-public IP address
```

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · What：The module is imported from the Host's own runtime by file URL, so it is the
same instance `web_fetch` already uses — not a second, disconnected copy.
Candidates are derived from the launched script and its ancestor directories
(the desktop Host passes the runtime root as `process.argv[2]`), then resolved
through the runtime's own Node resolution. No installation path is hard-coded.

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · What：Loopback traffic always stays direct. Hosts in `noProxy` keep their direct route
(model provider, account API), so stopping the proxy cannot strand a session.

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Install the policy at all. Set `false` to leave routes untouched. |
| `proxyUrl` | launch environment, else `http://127.0.0.1:7890` | Local HTTP(S) proxy URL; only `http://` / `https://` are accepted. Leave it out to follow the device. |
| `noProxy` | `deepseek.com,opencode.ai` | Comma-separated direct-connect suffixes. Loopback is always appended. |

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Configuration：Invalid explicit configuration fails activation with a message instead of
silently connecting directly.

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Which port is used：The local mixed port differs per machine and per proxy client (Clash for
Windows defaults to `7890`, Clash Verge to `7897`, others differ again), so the
plugin resolves the URL at mount time instead of baking one port into the
bundle:

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Which port is used：```
[outbound-proxy] installed http://127.0.0.1:7897 (noProxy=deepseek.com,opencode.ai, source=environment:https_proxy)
```

To set another port on a device, either put it in `~/.dsh/.env`
(`env/proxy.env` in this repository is a template) or add `proxyUrl` to the
row — see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md).

@local/dsh-outbound-proxy README · Files：- `index.js` — Host plugin (`apply`, URL resolution, validation, module location).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the `outbound-proxy` row; leaves `proxyUrl` out so
  each device follows its own environment, and sets the direct-connect list
  (`deepseek.com,opencode.ai`).
- `locale/{en,zh}.json` — display title/description.
- `icon.svg` — plugin icon.
- `INSTALL.md` — install/verify/uninstall notes.
